changeSet.sql: WITH new_clients AS ( INSERT INTO clients (name, email) SELECT (ARRAY['Alex', 'Maria', 'Ivan', 'Olga', 'Nina'])[1 + floor(random() * 5)::int] || ' ' || (ARRAY['Petrov', 'Stepanov', 'Ivanova', 'Leskova', 'Alexandrova', ])[1 + floor(random() * 5)::int], 'client-' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), 1, 16) || '@test.local' FROM generate_series(1, 10) RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO accounts (client_id, account_number, balance) SELECT c.id, 'ACC-' || substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), 1, 20), 0 FROM new_clients c CROSS JOIN generate_series(1, 3);
